reason: Even though I hate those dirty polythene chutney bags delivered with snacks, I cannot justify ₹99 for a tiny 100g tube on my monthly budget. A ₹72 bottle of ketchup or ₹70 pouch of Mother's Recipe gives double or five times the quantity.
objection: The product is priced like an elite luxury condiment that ordinary commuters cannot justify buying.
would_change_my_mind: A budget pocket pack or sachet strip priced around ₹20 to ₹30.
